# Functional Documentation

The functional documentation is a key element of the {{< var eugenia >}} project. Its purpose is to precisely describe all the expected features of the application from a conceptual perspective. It aims to consolidate the knowledge of the various contributors. In parallel with this section, the next part provides the technical documentation, detailing all the requirements for implementation.

In the first sections, we describe how the knowledge base is created (Section @#sec-knowledge-extraction), updated (Section @sec-reinforcement-learning) and presented through the user's personal interface (Section @sec-user-wiki). In the last sections (@sec-sn, @sec-discussion and @sec-other-sn-tools), we explore how this simple user interface can be extended to a broader network of users and what similarity principles are used to connect their topics of interest and themselves.

Throughout these descriptions, various definitions are provided. The first appears below and defines what {{< var eugenia >}} is.

::: {#def-line}

## {{< var eugenia >}}

Beyond being the name of the project, {{< var eugenia >}} is the user's assistant. It is an interface, connected to various artificial intelligence algorithms, designed to simplify user requests.
:::

In the following sections, we outline the implications of {{< var eugenia >}}.
